links.comparator_used: Standardized prompt without guideline information (post hoc subgroup of 12 cases)
links.outcome: Concordance with the expert guideline-based reference standard (0-2 score)
links.effect: Guideline-informed prompting significantly improved concordance for Gemini and Claude; no numeric effect sizes reported in the abstract, and no significant improvement was reported for ChatGPT.
links.quote: In the post hoc subgroup analysis, guideline-informed prompting significantly improved concordance for Gemini and Claude.
